The point labeled 'Site B' is positioned higher and to the right of Site A.
The point labeled 'Site C' is positioned higher and to the right of Site B.
The point labeled 'Site D' is positioned higher and to the right of Site C.
The point labeled 'Site E' is the highest and rightmost mark on the chart, appearing at the top of the y-axis scale.

public_definitions: The task requires assessing the dashboard view for selected sentinel sites to decide on a review route for a network-wide operational claim.
uncertain: The chart shows a strong positive correlation between testing volume and positive cases, but it does not provide statistical significance or confidence intervals to determine if this pattern is robust enough for a network-wide claim.
